camera.easing: Growth is fastest between 0:02 and 0:03 (+131px in 1920x1080 space from 0:02 to 0:03-late), then slows (+55, +55, +60) and stops by 0:06 (0:06 and 0:07 widths identical). Shape reads as ease-in-out with the fastest move mid-zoom, not linear. Exact easing curve cannot be fixed at 1-second sampling with +/-0.5s bucket uncertainty.

discrepancies_vs_browser_report: Report said October 2025 appears at 0:01; it is already visible in a frame whose timecode reads 0:00 (file 20261107T223547.730987966Z, '(keys clacking)' caption). It fades in during the first second.
Report said the caption changes to 'surrounded the city...' at 0:06; the 0:05 frame (20261107T223847.358401254Z) already shows that caption. The change happens during 0:05.

Report said EL FASHER appears at 0:06 (dim) and is bright at 0:07; measured: absent in the early-0:06 frame, at full brightness in the late-0:06 frame and at 0:07 (glyph peak luminance 246 vs 254). It fades in during 0:06, it does not brighten between 0:06 and 0:07.
Report said the frames are 1919x998; the snapshot files are 1919x1497 full-window images. The video area inside them is x 185-1717, y 55-885.
Report said RSF badge lands at 0:04; measured: it appears late in 0:03 (mid pop-in, half height) and is full size at 0:04.

mapping_caveat: Measured video rect is 1533x831 = 1.845:1, not 16:9. Either the browser display stretches the video vertically by about 4%, or the source is 1.85:1. Positions are mapped linearly from the displayed frame; treat y positions as accurate to about +/-15px in 1920x1080 space.
method: 10 frames picked from 27 browser screenshots (1919x1497 full window). Each frame chosen by its on-screen YouTube player timecode, read directly. Colours are 21x21 medians unless noted. Positions measured in screenshot pixels, then mapped to 1920x1080 video coordinates. No value was guessed.

label_white.note: SUDAN and EL FASHER glyphs: peak luminance 228 (SUDAN) and 254 (EL FASHER) at 0:07; median of bright pixels #BCC5C4 / #AAC3BF including anti-aliased edges. Reported as white.
